A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CaST-Bench study, with complete main text and supplementary material. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support comparison of all 32 pages, including equations, tables, figures, and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 15 VLMs, human and text-only baselines, causal-chain ablations, and qualitative failure analyses (Tables 3–5 and supplementary Sec. 13).

after.justification: v2 retains these original model evaluations, baseline results, ablations, and qualitative analyses unchanged.

M1.justification: The human–AI dataset construction pipeline, causal-chain output procedure, and instance-matching evaluation procedure remain unchanged in Secs. 3–4 and supplementary Secs. 10–12.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,015 SAV videos and 2,066 questions, covering the same four reasoning categories and multiple-choice and open-ended tasks.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same 15 VLMs and random, Gemini-2.5-Pro text-only, and human baselines. Comparator membership in the ablation and category comparisons in Tables 4–5 is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Input handling, frame sampling, evaluation metrics, grounding thresholds, generation limits, and judging procedures are unchanged in Sec. 5.1 and supplementary Secs. 11–12.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical causal-chain ablations, category analyses, distractor and open-ended analyses, and supplementary success/failure cases (Tables 4–5; Figures 6–7 and 15–18).

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports Gemini-2.5-Pro MCQ accuracy of 50.34% and human accuracy of 91.89% in both versions; supplementary case outcomes also match.

T1.justification: The formal task definition, metric definitions in Equations 1–3, and supplementary instance-matching specification are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contributions and claims about weak causal grounding and the benefits of accurate causal chains.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and failure explanations are unchanged. Sec. 14.2 retains the same limitations concerning annotation scalability, inherited SAV biases, and annotator preferences.

D1.justification: v2 adds a clickable project-homepage link to the abstract. Existing implementation details and the future-tense data/code release and licensing statement in Sec. 14.3 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, benchmark comparison in Table 1, and research positioning in Sec. 2 are unchanged. The new project-homepage link does not alter relationships to prior research.

P1.justification: A short homepage statement is appended to the abstract, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract link causes limited text reflow and spacing changes on pages 1–4. Figures, table structures, and captions are unchanged; pages 5–32 render identically.

improvement.justification: The new homepage link modestly improves project discoverability and access guidance. Scientific content, empirical evidence, and supplementary material are unchanged. Sec. 14.3 still promises a future data/code release, so the improvement is limited to the documented access pointer.
